correctness.rationale: The exact Park–Shin J_j spaces are used with K_C=4p, k=2, and the pole semigroup <2,7>. Seven explicit parity-pure formal lifts produce all nine graded generators, with zT8 and zT9 supplied by displayed cancellations; Lemma 8.3 then proves the upper bound. Through degree six the cotangent dimension is six; at degree seven only degree-five products could cancel upwards, but J2⊗J3→J5 is injective and direct degree-seven products have no z. Hence lower bound seven. verify.py checked finite supporting facts.

value.rationale: This computes the exact minimal analytic embedding dimension of a natural g=3 test germ in a recent family designed to test Wahl’s conjectures. The source bound six is not sharp: an essential degree-seven class forces the seventh generator, while syzygy cancellations control two later graded directions. This structurally differentiates genus three from the prior genus-two computation; no unsupported downstream theorem is claimed.
